WTFNB Weekly with Brevay

Seattle, WA · Road

WTFNB Weekly with Brevay is a road group ride in Seattle, WA. It rolls every Thursday at 6:30 am from Pacha Collective. About 15+ miles, moderate, 14–16 mph, frequent regroups. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 14–16 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the WTFNB Weekly with Brevay group ride

A weekly morning ride open to women, trans, femme and non-binary riders, regardless of presentation. Rolling road loop of 15-plus miles at a moderate pace with frequent regroups. Listed on the Everyday Rides calendar with 34 past editions.
